body: Real D keybind (H was already taken by ability-help toggle). New PACKET_ARENA_HOLD wire packet, arena_hold_position(owner) halts in place. Never chases a target that leaves range (drops the lock instead of pure-pursuing), but still opportunistically defends via attack-move's own engage scan, extended to cover held units too -- matters specifically for ranged heroes (Gary) whose basic attacks only fire through attack_target, unlike melee's always-on flat proximity loop. Cleared by any other group order, same 'a new command always wins' convention. 4 new tests, full suite + 10-bot stability green. Only patrol left, Milestone 2 stays IN PROGRESS. Commit c147691.
title: Hold Position command shipped: third slice of §24 Milestone 2
